description: In-scope intent classification from CLINC150 (clinc/oos-eval data_full.json). The separate oos_* out-of-scope splits are recorded but not used for this intent study.
intent_field: second element of each [text, intent] record
note: oos_* splits (out-of-scope) are recorded but not used in this intent study. Class-incremental chunks (5 x 30 intents, deterministic seed 12345) are recorded in each run's run_manifest.json under 'intent_order' and 'chunks'.
